description:
Manually create three new bibliographic items in Zotero with specific metadata. You must create one Book, one Journal Article, and one Conference Paper using the 'New Item' button (green plus icon) or File menu.

1. Create a Book:
   - Title: 'The Structure of Scientific Revolutions'
   - Author: 'Thomas S. Kuhn'
   - Date: '1962'
   - Publisher: 'University of Chicago Press'
   - Place: 'Chicago'

2. Create a Journal Article:
   - Title: 'The Strength of Weak Ties'
   - Author: 'Mark S. Granovetter'
   - Date: '1973'
   - Publication: 'American Journal of Sociology'
   - Volume: '78'
   - Issue: '6'
   - Pages: '1360-1380'

3. Create a Conference Paper:
   - Title: 'The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine'
   - Authors: 'Sergey Brin' and 'Lawrence Page' (two authors)
   - Date: '1998'
   - Proceedings Title: 'Proceedings of the 7th International World Wide Web Conference'
   - Pages: '107-117'

Ensure all fields are entered correctly. The items will be verified based on the metadata you enter.
